accounting.per_file_results: Diagnostic independently framed artifacts only; never substituted for the solid-archive primary denominator.
accounting.required_identity: Every component has an exact byte count and SHA-256; their sum equals complete_bundle_bytes.
accounting.tool_rule: The same self-contained distribution accounting applies to every candidate arm and baseline. Installed-codec payload-only sizes may be shown only as secondary context.

arms.purpose: Competent token+trivia control using the frozen adaptive integer range coder.

arms.occurrence_model: One first-occurrence spelling lexicon plus a single global identifier MTF list; no scope information.
arms.purpose: Isolate identifier spelling deduplication and flat occurrence coding.

arms.occurrence_model: The A1 spelling lexicon with only its occurrence stream replaced by deterministic lexical-scope NEW, FREE, and current-scope MTF-rank events.
arms.purpose: A2 minus A1 attributes only scope and binding identity.

baselines.dictionary: Trained only on dictionary_fit, frozen before either measured split, and counted once in every complete bundle.

baselines.decoder_asset: cmix v21 dictionary/english.dic is allowed only at its pinned 411996 bytes and SHA-256 4c8568cca9343b9a6212477880f56f8efd162f8784224a25edd043097d36215a, counted once.

claim_ceiling: Frozen Python-only development experiment. Passing G0 or G1 is not validation, a product win, a source-code category win, an Axiom win, independent reproduction, or state-of-the-art evidence.

coder.alphabet: unsigned integers emitted by canonical stream encoders
coder.arithmetic: 32-bit low/range integer arithmetic with renormalization below 2^24; no floating point
coder.byte_streams: bytes are integers 0..255 under the same adaptive model
coder.end_condition: counted symbol totals from the stream directory; no implicit EOF
coder.frequency_model: order-0 adaptive counts initialized to one, deterministic rescale at total 16384 using ceil(count/2)
coder.rule: The identical coder implementation, initialization, rescale rule, framing, and stream order is used by A0, A1, and A2.

corpus.file_filter: regular files whose canonical UTF-8 relative path ends in .py; all bytes are preserved exactly
corpus.symlink_and_nonregular_policy: excluded by the frozen derived-manifest builder; exclusion counts are reported
corpus.unicode_and_invalid_source_policy: bytes are never normalized; parser failure or undecodable source uses the counted raw fallback

dependencies.acquisition_lock: A separate canonical lock must freeze exact wheels/source archives, sizes, SHA-256 values, licenses, build commands, and decoder distribution roster before any corpus bytes or measurements are opened. Missing or changed lock fails closed.

cst.strategy: Lossless Module.bytes/code identity plus MetadataWrapper ScopeProvider; traversal is lexical source order with explicit conservative raw fallback for any unresolved or unsupported binding case.

dependencies.parser_identity_bytes: The exact ASCII parser name, version, dependency-lock SHA-256, grammar flags, and fallback policy are stored in each A1/A2 format header and counted.
dependencies.runtime: CPython 3.12.x patch version frozen in the acquisition lock; interpreter/stdlib files required by the decoder are counted in its distribution component.

format.fallbacks: Every file has a counted mode flag. Parser error, unsupported syntax, ambiguous scope metadata, limit breach, or noncanonical CST identity routes the complete original file to a raw-byte stream.

identifier_events.a1: Global MTF rank into the shared first-occurrence spelling lexicon; new spelling insertion is explicit.
identifier_events.a2_free: FREE plus lexical ancestor distance and MTF rank in the target ancestor; module-unresolved names use the explicit module-free table.
identifier_events.a2_mtf: MTF plus rank in the current lexical scope table.
identifier_events.a2_new: NEW plus global spelling-lexicon ID on the first binding definition in the current lexical scope.
identifier_events.mutation: NEW/FREE/MTF moves the referenced entry to the front of exactly the table named by the event.

format.tokenization: Python tokenize semantics are cross-checked against LibCST byte identity; exact byte gaps, encodings, BOMs, line endings, comments, and trailing bytes are explicit streams.

g0_training_signal.route_on_fail: Kill GDB1 without opening development_holdout. Retain the complete training result as negative evidence.

g1_development_strong.route_on_fail: Reject validation admission and publish development evidence. Do not tune on development_holdout.

product_reminder.requirements: Separately frozen public validation then sealed private holdout, practical speed tier, bounded memory, streaming, corruption resistance, portability, and independent reproduction.

measurement.development_holdout_access: Exactly once, only after a verified G0 pass and immutable publication of its result and dependency/corpus bindings.
measurement.primary_unit: One solid archive over the complete split, with complete self-contained bundle accounting.
